injection_details.method: Code-cave injection into the process's own mapped PE image: find_code_cave() -> VirtualProtectEx(PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE 0x40) -> WriteProcessMemory -> VirtualProtectEx(PAGE_EXECUTE_READ 0x20) -> CreateRemoteThread, with NtCreateThreadEx as fallback
injection_details.target_process: Self (current process). Handle from GetCurrentProcess(); target module base from GetModuleHandleA(NULL) — i.e. the sample injects into its own image, no external victim process is opened (no OpenProcess/CreateToolhelp32Snapshot imported)
injection_details.target_discovery: find_code_cave() at 0x140001664 walks the in-memory PE: validates 'MZ' (0x5A4D) and 'PE\0\0' (0x4550), iterates IMAGE_SECTION_HEADERs looking for sections with IMAGE_SCN_MEM_EXECUTE (0x20000000). Strategy 1: use the slack between Misc.VirtualSize and SizeOfRawData (returns base + VirtualAddress + SizeOfRawData). Strategy 2: byte-scan the executable section for a contiguous run of 0xCC (INT3 padding) or 0x00 bytes at least payload-size long and return the run start.
injection_details.payload_write: WriteProcessMemory(hProc, cave, decrypted_shellcode, 0x30, &written) after flipping the cave page to PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE with VirtualProtectEx; protection is restored to PAGE_EXECUTE_READ before execution. On WriteProcessMemory failure the original protection is restored and the routine bails out.
injection_details.payload_size: 0x30 (48) bytes, stored XOR-encrypted in .data as g_encrypted_shellcode (0x140003000)
injection_details.execution: CreateRemoteThread(hProc, NULL, 0, cave, NULL, 0, NULL); if it returns NULL, resolve_nt_func() does GetModuleHandleA("ntdll.dll") + GetProcAddress("NtCreateThreadEx") and calls it with DesiredAccess 0x1FFFFF and StartRoutine = cave. Then WaitForSingleObject(hThread, 5000) and CloseHandle.
injection_details.notable: No VirtualAlloc/VirtualAllocEx is used at all — the payload is hidden in existing executable section padding, avoiding new RWX private allocations.

encryption_details.algorithm: Two layers: (1) Real payload = repeating-key XOR (12-byte key) applied by xor_decrypt() at 0x140001480. (2) Decoy 'AES-128' — aes128_decrypt_block() at 0x1400014EF is NOT real AES: it performs 10 rounds of byte-wise state[j] = AES_SBox[state[j]] ^ key[j] ^ (27*round) with no ShiftRows/MixColumns/key schedule, and uses the FORWARD S-box. It decrypts g_encrypted_block into a stack buffer that is never referenced again (dead code / analyst decoy).
encryption_details.key: XOR key (g_xor_key, 12 bytes @0x140004000): C3 7A 9F 2E 55 8B 1D 6C E4 31 A8 4F  |  AES-ish key (g_aes_key, 16 bytes @0x140004120): '4xdm1n_S3cr3t!!!'
encryption_details.key_storage: Both keys are hard-coded plaintext in the read-only .rdata section; the AES key is directly adjacent to the plaintext strings 'ntdll.dll' and 'NtCreateThreadEx' (0x140004130/0x14000413A). The full standard AES S-box is embedded at g_aes_sbox (0x140004020). No key derivation, no runtime key material.

dynamic_api_resolution: NtCreateThreadEx is resolved at runtime via GetModuleHandleA("ntdll.dll") + GetProcAddress instead of being imported, hiding it from static import analysis

transient_page_protection: cave page is only PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE during the write and is reverted to PAGE_EXECUTE_READ before thread creation
